name: Do I need a permit for electrical work during a remodel in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for electrical work during a remodel in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most electrical work performed during a remodel in Berkeley, and throughout the East Bay, requires a permit. This is to ensure that the work complies with local building codes and safety standards. Our team handles the necessary permit applications and ensures all work passes inspection. This protects your home's safety and ensures compliance with local regulations.
